folder <- "library"

imgs <- list.files(pattern = "(jpg|png)$"
                   , recursive = T) %>% 
  keep(~grepl(folder, .)) %>% 
  discard(~grepl("docs", .)) %>%
  enframe(name = "num", value = "path") %>% 
  mutate(url = file.path("https://flavjack.github.io/pheno-maiz/", path))

imgs %>% 
  select(url) %>% 
  write_csv("images4labelstudio.txt", col_names = F)
